messages.en: I got to the counter, but unfortunately the tickets were already sold out.
Oh, what a shame! Let's just catch tomorrow's screening, then.

collocations.en: be embarrassed to admit a mistake

messages.en: How embarrassing! I called him by the wrong name earlier.
It's okay, just say sorry. He'll understand.
Mum, have you eaten yet? I'm about to get some food.
Not yet. Get me a portion of chicken rice, will you?

senses.en_definition: Having the ability or financial means to do something.

collocations.en: be able to afford a house
be able to solve a problem

messages.en: This new phone looks nice, doesn't it? Don't you want to get a new one too?
I'd love to, but I can't afford one right now. I've got a lot of expenses this month.
I get it. Just stick with your old one for now. It's still working fine anyway.
